inShort: A feeds dinks, and B plays topspin dinks (aka rolls) to two targets in turn: wide at A's sideline, then at A's inside foot.
rules: A and B stand diagonally at the kitchen line, B on the left half. Optional: a cone near A's outside sideline and one at A's inside foot (the foot nearer the middle).
Forehand round: A dinks every ball to the middle of B's half. B plays a topspin dink: wide, inside, wide, inside.
After each ball, A steps back to the middle.
A topspin dink only counts if it bounces on A's side. If A can calmly take it out of the air, it does not count.
Backhand round: A feeds to B's backhand, same order. Between topspin dinks, lean in with the paddle out in front.
10 topspin dinks per round, then swap roles.
tooEasy: Count: 7 of 10 topspin dinks on target and bouncing, on each side. Even harder: A tries to take every one out of the air and gets back to the middle faster.
tooHard: A feeds slower, and the targets get bigger.
goodLooksLike: The topspin dinks land on target and bounce, and A's replies come back to the middle.
